scientific.integrity: The theorem is proved for all integer orders by a strict discrete majorization argument plus a parity feasibility lemma. Reproducibility includes exhaustive small-order tests for the exact equality sets, distinct from the infinite proof. Primary area literature was inspected directly and the perimeter problem was compared by implication, not by title.
limitations: The exact solution requires equally spaced pairs and strictly concave integer-gap edge costs.
The area extremal configurations were already described in earlier literature; novelty concerns the perimeter quantities and universal edge-gap energy theorem.
A musically formulated or unindexed historical equivalent may exist.

title: Sharp perimeter and concave gap-energy laws for antipodal lattice polygons
